title: The Locked Section
description: The Locked Section holds what the Circle decided nobody should carry alone. You may have one shelf: a necromancer's ledgers, a blood-rite transcript, or a diary that ends mid-sentence. Each of them takes something, and I will want to see what is left.

objectives.description: Take the vault key from Elara
Go down into the Locked Section
Choose your one shelf at the forbidden bookshelf
objectives.notes: Dialogue choice: Necromancy, Blood Magic, or Dimensional Travel

objectives.description: Read what the Circle locked away
Try it where it can only reach you
objectives.notes: Use the spell in a safe area

objectives.description: Tell Elara what you will do with it
objectives.notes: Dialogue choice affects reputation and spell access

notes: Threat: the tome is its own cost - reading it changes the student, named concretely in the description (a stammer, a taste, an unfamiliar name answered to) rather than a game-mechanical harm. Giver motive: Elara is testing whether an Adept who has touched forbidden knowledge stays a Circle asset or becomes a liability - every Adept she vouches for is her name on the line with the council. UNWIRED BRANCH: the file promises a moral choice at `moral_choice` and ships one path. It should split on how the player answers Elara: `forbidden_knowledge_concealed` (lie about what was learned, keep the darker application, arcane_circle reputation penalty) versus `forbidden_knowledge_reported` (report honestly, shelf resealed, no penalty, milder reward). No such choice_consequences entry exists and none is added here - hard limits forbid adding one. A later pass should wire it. First Adept quest. PREREQUISITE FIX: the value in `prerequisites` was a FLAG name, not a quest id - QuestManager reads that list as completed QUEST ids, so this quest was never available and the ladder was dead from mage_02 down. Moved to `flag_prerequisites`, which is the list of flags that is actually checked; the flag itself is raised by the previous quest's on_complete_flags.
